verdict.rationale: LiteLLM is an LLM gateway and SDK. Nothing in the evidence shows a feature for users to set up recurring or autonomous background automations, such as scheduled jobs, triggers, or agent runs. Traffic mirroring runs a silent model in the background, and budgets reset on a schedule, but these are adjacent internal behaviors, not user-defined automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
